text:
alex.k: Heads up — vendor (Nexasupply) just proposed splitting RMA shipment: 6 units air (expedite) + 14 sea. Air will clear customs faster but there's a $5k surcharge rollover on PO-4992. Thoughts?
vendor_liaison: Confirmed. Air AWB will be two shipments: AWB12345 (6) + AWB67890 (14). Surcharge applies to air legs only. We can split invoice per AWB.
sam_ops: Are the 6 air units enough to cover Dedicated pool shortfall this week? We need at least 8 to keep SLAs.
alex.k: No, that's short. Vendor said they can bump to 8 if we eat extra $1k per unit or accept later ETA (3d vs 10d).
maria_f: Finance — need exact invoice split and TAX docs. If we pay extra per unit, cap us at $9k total (approval limit) else need FP sign-off.
jordan_infra: Also note cluster health: if we only get 6/8, autoscaler triggers will be impacted for eu-west-2. We should prioritize nodes in eu-west-2.
vendor_liaison: We can re-route 2 more into AWB12345 but that'll change weight and may hit different surcharge band. Let me get final numbers.
ops-bot: Deployment reminder: Dedicated pool fallback policy will start shifting traffic at 03:00 UTC if capacity < 90% for 6h.
alex.k: Ok can we do quick calc: option A: 8 air (ETA 72h) at +$1k/unit = +$2k additional => total surcharge X. Option B: 6 air + 14 sea (ETA 10d) but we get invoice split.
maria_f: Option A within budget if total <= $9k, else escalate.
sam_ops: If we go A, need RMA labels and serial manifest prepped. vendor_liaison can you push labels + photos to depot?
vendor_liaison: Yes — will attach manifest + photos. Format:
```
PO: PO-4992
AWB: AWB12345 (8 units)
Serials: S12345678,S12345679,S12345680,S12345681,S12345682,S12345683,S12345684,S12345685
Depot: FRA-DEPOT-7
```
alex.k: Also confirm whether return AWB will be consolidated or per unit — affects depot throughput.
vendor_liaison: Return AWB will be consolidated, but depot wants separate rma labels per serial. We'll provide both.
jordan_infra: If air hits customs fees, can we route through eu-central spare lane? Might reduce surcharge but add 24h.
sam_ops: If we shift to eu-central we still need cross-region transfer and network security for private deployment — Ops needs lead time.
alex.k: Decision: vendor — get firm quote for 8 air (exact surcharge), provide split invoice draft and serial manifest + photos by EOD. We'll decide after finance confirms cap.
maria_f: I'll review and confirm by 17:00 PST.
vendor_liaison: On it. Sending preliminary numbers in 30m.
alex.k: thanks :thumbsup:
